originalTitle: SpaceX draws retail investors despite fall in shares post earnings
simplifiedContent: SpaceX recently released its first earnings report since becoming a publicly traded company, and its stock price dropped as a result. Even though the price fell, many individual investors still bought SpaceX shares, spending over $22 million on Wednesday. This is notable because it shows that despite the decline in stock price, which fell below $110, many retail investors still want to own a part of the company. The company did report some positive news, including increased revenue from artificial intelligence and new cloud agreements. This buying activity suggests that individual investors are still interested in SpaceX, even after the stock price drop.

originalTitle: Circle shares fall nearly 4% as revenue miss overshadows quarterly profit beat
simplifiedContent: Here's what happened with Circle's stock: the company made more profit than expected in the second quarter, which is a good thing. This happened because more people are using something called USDC tokens, which is a positive trend for the company. However, Circle didn't make as much money as expected from its overall business, which is called a "revenue miss". As a result, the company's stock price fell by almost 4%. This matters because it shows that even when a company does some things well, it can still have problems in other areas that affect its stock price.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a small increase on a day with a lot of ups and downs, especially at the end of the trading session. This happened even though the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) decided not to change interest rates, which is an important decision that can affect the market. The RBI also said it thinks the economy will grow more and inflation will be less than previously thought, which is good news. Some types of stocks, like real estate, auto, and metal companies, did better than others. The market is expected to stay stable unless the main stock index, Nifty, crosses a certain point, 24,800.

originalTitle: Treasury yields fall as oil dips on Strait of Hormuz hopes
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: the interest rates on US government debt, called Treasury yields, have gone down. This is because the price of oil has decreased, which is linked to hopes of a peaceful resolution regarding the Strait of Hormuz. The Strait of Hormuz is an important route for oil transportation, and any tensions there can affect oil prices. When oil prices go down, it can lead to lower interest rates on government debt, which is what's happening with Treasury yields. This matters because it can impact the overall direction of the stock market and economy.

originalTitle: LIC share sale ends with partial retail subscription
simplifiedContent: The Indian government recently tried to sell a part of a big company called LIC, which is worth $3.3 billion. They wanted to sell some of the shares to regular people, like individual investors, but not as many people bought in as they had hoped. Only 69% of the shares that were set aside for individuals were actually sold. This is interesting because while regular people didn't show as much interest, big institutions like banks and investment firms were very interested in buying the shares. This might be a sign that regular people are being more cautious about investing in the stock market.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold jumps $173, silver hits $63 as US-Iran peace hopes lift sentiment
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening with gold and silver prices: they're going up because people are hopeful about the US and Iran talking and finding peace. This is making investors feel more positive, which is helping gold and silver prices rise. Gold went up by $173 to $4,325, and silver reached $63. A weaker US dollar is also contributing to the increased demand for these metals, which is why their prices are increasing. This matters because it shows that investors are feeling more optimistic about the future, which can impact the overall stock market.
